description: Land Acquisition - Medagama (Part) and Pulanchiya (Part), Galgamuwa D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Amendment to the notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1929/05 of 24.08.2015 by Kandy and Gangawata Korale D/S Division
reasoning: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically detailing the acquisition of multiple land lots for public purpose (road development).
